title: Galax-z v9
description: Galax-z v8 with more voices played live: bass 6, lead 10, arp 6, chord 10.
notes: Hold more keys: played live, lead and chord sound 10 notes at once, bass and arp 6.
Patterns keep their own voices, so playing over them no longer cuts them off.
If far too much is held for the OP-Z to keep up, the oldest live note is let go, so it does not freeze.
